releaseFreeze: Before first participant, record the actual immutable /releases/<id>/ URL, build identity and exact material SHA. Stop if anything differs; no participants have been tested.

sources.title: NASA PGDA high-resolution south polar LOLA DEMs

selection.rule: Fixed before observing human results: one failing sample, center passes, darkness-only failure, three feasible alternatives, same 168 h and 24/24/24 h conditions. Cases differ in month, site and failing direction.
selection.screenedCandidateDefinition: Three published campaigns, three sites, six-hour starts, 168 h and 24/24/24 h. 40 center-pass, 8/9 cases were found before choosing these two; no human observations were inspected.

coverage.interpretation: Only complete mission intervals on the stated search grid are evaluated. A partial date range is not a no-solution finding for missing dates.
